# GroupBox

Header: `winui/ui/containers/GroupBox.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/containers/GroupBox.hpp`.

A header over a group of related controls, with the group framed.

It takes no input and no focus of its own, so [Tab](../controls/tabs.md#uitab) moves straight to the controls inside. It groups only visually. Radio buttons inside still need a [RadioGroup](../controls/radio-button.md#class-radiogroup) or a [RadioButtons](../controls/radio-buttons.md#uiradiobuttons) control to be exclusive.

Example: 
```cpp
auto box = std::make_unique<ui::GroupBoxControl>("Appearance");
box->set_child(std::make_unique<ui::CheckBoxControl>("Show the status bar"));
window.set_content(std::move(box));

// Declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::GroupBox{
    .header  = "Appearance",
    .content = ui::CheckBox{.text = "Show the status bar"},
});
```

## `ui::GroupBox`

A header over a group of related controls, with the group framed. Builds a [ui::GroupBoxControl](#uigroupboxcontrol).

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::GroupBox{
    .header  = "Appearance",
    .content = ui::VerticalStack{
        .spacing = 8,
        .content = {
            ui::CheckBox{.text = "Show the status bar"},
            ui::CheckBox{.text = "Show line numbers"},
        },
    },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::GroupBox{
    .header, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width,
    .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip,
    .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus,
    .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uigroupbox-header"></span>`header` | `ui::Binding<std::string>` |  | The header text. Empty draws no header. |
| <span id="uigroupbox-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uigroupbox-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uigroupbox-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uigroupbox-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uigroupbox-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uigroupbox-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uigroupbox-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::GroupBox>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uigroupbox-content"></span>`content` | `ui::Spec` |  | The grouped content. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

A header over a group of related controls, with the group framed.

It takes no input and no focus of its own, so [Tab](../controls/tabs.md#uitab) moves straight to the controls inside. It groups only visually. ### hit_test_transparent

```cpp
bool hit_test_transparent() const override
```

Returns false, so the group box is hit anywhere in its bounds, even where it draws nothing.

### header

### parallel_measure_safe

bool parallel_measure_safe() const override

Returns true, since measuring touches only the header text and the child.
